senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אָנָה)to press, be pressed; to be detained.
to detain, postpone, esp. ע׳ דין to delay execution of capital judgment (which should take place on the day of sentence).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 11:4">Snh. XI, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Sanhedrin 89a:3">89ᵃ</cite>) <he>אין מְעַנִּין את דינו של וכ׳</he> we must not put off his execution (opp. to the opinion <he>משמרין אותו</he>). Ib. 35ᵃ <he>וליגמריה … נמצא אתה מְעַנֶּה את דינו</he> shall we pass sentence on Friday and put him to death on Sunday? In such a case you would postpone his execution (against the law); v. <cite ref="P00612"><he>עִינּוּי</he> II</cite>.

senses.gloss: to cause privation; to cause to fast.
units: Yoma 77ᵇ (ref. to ויענה, Gen. XXXIV, 2) התם שעִינָּהּ מביאות וכ׳ this may be interpreted, that he deprived her of other connections. Ib. VIII, 4 התינוקות אין מענין אותן וכ׳ we must not let children fast on the Day of Atonement, v. חָנַךְ; a. e.—Part. pass. מְעוּנֶּה fasting.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ta'anit 2:7">Tosef. Taan. II, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 41a:1">Erub. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>כדי שלא יכנס לשבת כשהוא מע׳</he> that he may not begin the Sabbath fasting; Tanḥ.

senses.gloss: to afflict, oppress, wrong. Mekh. Mishp., s. 18 (ref. to Ex. XXII, 22) עד שיְעַנֶּה וישנה until he practices oppression repeatedly; a. e.—Part. pass. מְעוּנֶּה; pl. מְעוּנִּין.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 48b:15">Yeb. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>מפני מה גרים בזמן הזה מע׳ וכ׳</he> why are the proselytes of our days afflicted and subject to suffering?

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 9:7">Num. R. s. 9</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Micah 2:9">Mic. II, 9</cite>) <he>שהיו מְעַנִּים נשי וכ׳</he> they violated married women and caused them to be forbidden to their husbands.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 19">Lev. R. s. 19</cite>; a. fr.—Mekh. l. c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 349:6">Yalk. Ex. 349</cite> <he>אם כשלא תְעַנּוּן את הדין וכ׳</he> if your wives will be spared from widowhood and your children from bereavement, because you do not violate justice, how much more, when you execute justice.

senses.gloss: to be afflicted, oppressed. Mekh. l. c. אלמנה … שדרכן לֵעָנוֹת בהן וכ׳ widows and orphans who are liable to be oppressed,—of them the text speaks (Ex. XXII, 21); Yalk. l. c. שדרכן לֵיעָנוֹת (not שדרכו).
to humble one’s self; to submit to a person’s discretion, beg pardon.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 28a:10">Ber. 28ᵃ</cite> <he>נַעֲנֵיתִי לך מחול לי</he> I submit myself to thee, forgive me.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 38:1">Pesik. R. s. 38</cite> <he>נעניתי לו</he> I beg his pardon.
<cite ref="Yoma 22b:18">Yoma 22ᵇ</cite> <he>נעניתי לכם עצמות וכ׳</he> I beg your pardon, bones of Saul!; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 117:3">Yalk. Sam. 117</cite> <he>נעניתי לך שאול וכ׳</he>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 67b:7">Keth. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>נעניתי לך קום אכול</he> I beg of thee, get up and eat.
<cite ref="Tosefta Ohalot 5:12">Tosef. Ohol. V, 12</cite> <he>נמיתי לכם עצמות וכ׳</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>נמתי</he>, read <he>נעניתי</he>) I beg your pardon, bones of &c.
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 130:5">Sifré Deut. 130</cite> <he>שנִתְעַנּוּ</he>, v. <cite ref="P00612"><he>עִינּוּי</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Berakhot 8b:3">Ber. 8ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 23:32">Lev. XXIII, 32</cite>) <he>וכי בתשעה מִתְעַנִּין</he> do men fast on the ninth (of Tishri)? <cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 18b">R. Hash. 18ᵇ</cite> <he>אין גזרת … רצו מתענין</he> when there is no political persecution, but no peace, those who wish may fast &c.
<cite ref="Eruvin 41a:8">Erub. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>והִתְעַנִּינוּ בו ולא וכ׳</he> we fasted, but not to the end of the day; a. fr.
<cite ref="Berakhot 33a:27">Ber. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>חזרו והֶעֱנוּ</he> when they (the Jews) became poor again.
<cite ref="Meilah 17a:32">Meïl. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>מי שיש לו אויב יַעֲנִי או יעשיר</he> if one has an enemy, does one wish him to be poor or rich?; a. e.
